description: In UP, Madrasa students are set to learn AI and coding amidst a digital literacy thrust. The move aims to align madrassa education with mainstream education systems, equipping students with a robust digital education.
body_lead: UP govt brings AI and coding to madrassa curriculum In UP, Madrasa students are set to learn AI and coding amidst a digital literacy thrust. The move aims to align madrassa education with mainstream education systems, equipping students with a robust digital education. The Uttar Pradesh (UP) government has decided to introduce artificial intelligence and coding to madrassa students. This initiative has been planned and taken forward by the Yogi government to equip madrassa students with a robust digital education and bring them in line with other education boards.
